requirements.rule: Art. 58 c. 3: the net cap of the apprentice pay.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: art. 158 c.1 (2010 text, p. 140) grants the six scatti 'a tutto il personale' and art. 58 pays the apprentice a percentage of the normale retribuzione of the qualified worker, which art. 148 defines with the scatti: apprentices accrue the level amount. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship; the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments.
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

requirements.rule: APPRENTICESHIP DURATIONS: the durations of the professionalizzante come from the accord of 17 April 2012 as amended in 2014, of which no signed or CNEL copy was found (only aggregator copies); the percentages of art. 58 are verified. Every apprentice run carries this limitation.
requirements.remediation: Read a signed copy of the accord of 17 April 2012 and its 2014 amendment.

requirements.rule: LEAVE, STABILIMENTI BALNEARI (Art. 111 c.2): 108 hours of reduction a year instead of 104. The engine accrues the 104 hours of alberghi, pubblici esercizi, campeggi, alberghi diurni and agenzie di viaggi.
requirements.remediation: Add an employer fact for the comparto and accrue 108 hours for the stabilimenti balneari.

requirements.rule: Artt. 160 c. 4 and 161 c. 6: the ratei of the tredicesima and quattordicesima during maternity, paternity and parental leave. The caller can suspend the accrual of an absence (AbsenceEvent.suspends_accrual); the engine does not apply the CCNL rule itself (review of 2026-10-30).
requirements.remediation: Accrue the ratei during the leaves.

requirements.rule: Art. 155 c. 3, p. 44: the hourly table of the extra workers.
Art. 158 c. 2-3: the first scatto counted from age 18 and from the month after the triennium.
requirements.remediation: Count the first scatto from age 18.

requirements.rule: Art. 13 c. 10, pp. 11-12: the elemento economico di garanzia paid with the November 2027 pay without an integrative agreement by 31 October 2026 (A and B 186, 1-3 158, 4-5 140, 6s-7 112).
requirements.remediation: Model the 2027 guarantee element as a conditional allowance.

requirements.rule: Verbale of 30 November 2016: the lower ramp of the hires of 14 November 2016. The caller pays these amounts as variable items.

The INPS maternity indemnity of an operaia, or of a leave whose month before was not worked in full, is computed on the pay of the run over 30 with the rateo of the extra months, not on the pay of the month before the leave: art. 23 c. 5 D.Lgs. 151/2001 divides the pay of an operaia by the days worked or paid (or by the hours, when fewer than the contract), and the divisor of her daily rateo of the 13th is not settled by a primary source. The base of another worker over a whole month is computed from MaternityLeaveEvent.maternity_base_pay.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.base.rules.leave_base; D.Lgs. 151/2001 art. 23 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 f5d5e1ff3028f8249597c78f9371063f0de7790676054b5f0207c974bc50bc04)
requirements.remediation: Source the daily rateo of an operaia (an INPS circular on art. 23 c. 5) and compute her base and that of a month not worked in full, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The INPS indemnity of the compulsory paternity leave of an operaio, or of a leave whose month before was not worked in full, is computed on the pay of the run over 30 with the rateo of the extra months, not on the pay of the month before the leave: art. 29 D.Lgs. 151/2001 applies art. 23, whose c. 5 divides the pay of a manual worker by the days worked or paid (or by the hours) with a daily rateo no primary source settles. The base of another worker over a whole month is computed from PaternityLeaveEvent.paternity_base_pay.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.absence.insured.base.rules.leave_base; D.Lgs. 151/2001 artt. 23 and 29 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-30, page sha256 f5d5e1ff3028f8249597c78f9371063f0de7790676054b5f0207c974bc50bc04 and 3bfcc58c0e6f305f8971925b355d864c9bdf203e187fe40503c0df2aeca8a94a)
requirements.remediation: Source the daily rateo of a manual worker under art. 23 c. 5 and compute his base and that of a month not worked in full, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The run reads an INPS ruleset marked provisional: the INPS circulars of its year are not published yet, so the rates, the massimale and the minimale (and the hourly contributions of domestic work) are those of the year before, carried over. The indexed amounts change every January: the carried-over values understate them.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional INPS ruleset of the year with the values of the INPS circulars of the year, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The run reads a tax ruleset marked provisional: the sources of its year are not published yet (budget law of the year; regional and municipal surtax resolutions), so the values are those of the year before, carried over. Rules in force by statute (the IRPEF brackets of art. 11 and the deductions of art. 13 of the testo unico of D.Lgs. 117/2026) carry over unchanged; any change of the budget law is not applied.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional ruleset of the year with the values of its published sources, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: Art. 145: the absorption of the Quadri allowance into individual treatments.

The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
requirements.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.

requirements.rule: SICKNESS (art. 228, 2010 text p. 184): the CCNL integrates up to a share of the net daily pay without saying how the net pay is computed; the engine grosses up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate, as for the Commercio file. Day 1 of the carenza is the worker's when the illness lasts three days or less (c.5): the engine pays all three days. For fixed-term and seasonal workers no integration is due past the end of the contract (c.2).
requirements.remediation: Model the net daily pay of art. 228, the unpaid first day of a short illness and the end of a fixed-term contract.

requirements.rule: Art. 152 c. 2 as replaced in 2024, p. 43: the lower paga base of 1-2 star hotels and campsites up to 1200 presenze (level 4 1,688.98 instead of 1,695.69 from May 2026).
requirements.remediation: Add an employer fact for the small-hotel table.

requirements.rule: An apprentice whose TFR goes to a pension fund or to the Fondo Tesoreria takes the 0.28-point relief of D.L. 203/2005 art. 8, but not the exemption from the 0.20% Fondo di garanzia contribution of D.Lgs. 252/2005 art. 10 c. 2: no source found says whether the apprentice rate (10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus NASpI and the integration funds) holds a Fondo di garanzia share to exempt. The employer contributions of the run may be overstated by 0.20% of the INPS base.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.severance.relief.services; INPS messaggio n. 5859 of 7 March 2008, par. 3 (art. 8 relief of apprentices); INPS circ. 70/2007 par. 6 (Fondo di garanzia exemption, rates 0.20% and 0.40%)
requirements.remediation: Find an INPS source on the Fondo di garanzia share of the apprentice rate, then exempt it with the other workers or record that none is due.

requirements.rule: TRATTAMENTO INTEGRATIVO SPECIALE (L. 199/2025 art. 1 cc. 18-20, Gazzetta Ufficiale text, https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/atto/serie_generale/caricaArticolo?art.codiceRedazionale=26A00149&art.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=2026-01-21&art.flagTipoArticolo=0&art.idArticolo=1&art.idGruppo=1&art.idSottoArticolo=1&art.idSottoArticolo1=10&art.progressivo=1&art.versione=1, page sha256 e05f6f864509f87e7488cdae075fe3a1f2632f6f4577b87ee05479a1ed193c1d): from 1 January to 30 September 2026 the workers of the esercizi di somministrazione di alimenti e bevande (L. 287/1991 art. 5) and of the 'comparto del turismo, ivi inclusi gli stabilimenti termali', with employment income of 2025 not above 40,000 EUR, receive 'un trattamento integrativo speciale, che non concorre alla formazione del reddito, pari al 15 per cento delle retribuzioni lorde corrisposte in relazione al lavoro notturno e alle prestazioni di lavoro straordinario [...] effettuate nei giorni festivi'. The employer pays it 'su richiesta del lavoratore' (c. 20), a fact the request has no field for: the engine does not pay it, so the net pay of a worker who asked for it is understated.
requirements.remediation: Add the worker's request of c. 20 to the request, pay 15% of the night and holiday overtime pay of the run as a credit, then remove this note.
